title.ja: 図1-1 矢倉囲いの基本
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basics of the Yagura castle

explain.ja: 矢倉囲いは図1-1の囲いを基本にさまざまなバリエーションがあります。図1-1の囲いは単に「矢倉囲い」、他の矢倉と区別して「金矢倉」と呼ばれます。定義は特に定まっていませんが、銀を7七に置いて8筋を守る囲いは矢倉に分類されることが多いです。相居飛車で出てくる最も基本的な囲いで、矢倉戦法で使います。
explain.en: The Yagura castle has many variations based on the one in Figure 1-1, which is called simply Yagura or, to distinguish it from other Yagura, Gold Yagura (金矢倉). There is no fixed definition, but a castle with a silver on 7七 guarding the 8th file is usually classified as Yagura. It is the most basic castle in double Static Rook and is used in Yagura openings.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いってどんな囲い?定義はあるの?
section.en: What kind of castle is Yagura? Is there a definition?

title.ja: 図1-2 カニ囲いの組み方
title.en: Figure 1-2: How to build the Crab castle

explain.ja: まず金銀3枚を1マス前に進めて玉を寄ります。図1-2の形は「カニ囲い」と呼ばれ、この囲いをさらに変形させて矢倉囲いを組んでいきます。
explain.en: First advance the three gold/silver pieces one square and shift the king over. The shape in Figure 1-2 is called Kani-gakoi (crab castle), and it is further transformed into the Yagura.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build Yagura: the sequence

title.ja: 図1-3 矢倉囲いの外枠が完成
title.en: Figure 1-3: The outer frame of the Yagura castle is complete

explain.ja: 図1-2からさらに銀と金を上げれば、矢倉囲いの外枠が完成します。あとは玉を8八に入れれば矢倉囲いの完成です。
explain.en: Raising the silver and gold further from Figure 1-2 completes the outer frame of the Yagura. Then putting the king on 8八 finishes it.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build Yagura: the sequence

explain.ja: 玉を囲いに入れるため、まず8八にいる角を退かします。ここまで来れば、矢倉囲いはほぼ完成したも同然です。
explain.en: To put the king into the castle, first move the bishop off 8八. At this point the Yagura is nearly complete.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build Yagura: the sequence

title.ja: 図1-5 玉を入城させる
title.en: Figure 1-5: Bring the king into the castle

explain.ja: 玉を矢倉のお城に入れれば「矢倉囲い」の完成です。組み方にはいくつか手順のパターンがあります。矢倉囲いは基本的には相居飛車で使われ、矢倉戦法は囲いの名前がそのまま戦法名になっています。角換わり戦でも矢倉囲いを目指すのが一般的です。対振り飛車ではほとんど使われず、舟囲い、左美濃、穴熊が使われることが多いです。矢倉囲いは横から攻められるのが弱点で、矢倉崩しのパターンを知っておくと実戦で役立ちます。
explain.en: Moving the king into the Yagura completes the castle; there are several move orders for building it. Yagura is basically used in double Static Rook, and the Yagura opening is named after the castle itself. In Bishop Exchange games too, players generally aim for Yagura. It is rarely used against Ranging Rook, where Funagakoi, Left Mino or Anaguma are common. Its weakness is lateral attacks, so knowing the patterns of breaking Yagura helps in real games.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build Yagura: the sequence

explain.ja: まずはスタンダードな「金矢倉」で、単に矢倉囲いと言うときはこの囲いを指します。相居飛車で最も基本的な囲いで、矢倉戦や角換わりで登場します。上部からの攻めには強いですが横からの攻めには弱く、対振り飛車ではあまり使われません。
explain.en: First is the standard Gold Yagura, which is what "Yagura" alone means. It is the most basic castle in double Static Rook and appears in Yagura and Bishop Exchange games. It is strong against attacks from above but weak against lateral ones and is not often used against Ranging Rook.

explain.ja: 「カニ囲い」は矢倉囲いを組む途中にできる囲いで、左右の金をカニのハサミに見立てています。守りは強くありませんが、手数がかからないのでカニ囲いのまま速攻を仕掛けることもできます。
explain.en: The Kani-gakoi arises while building Yagura; the two golds are likened to a crab's claws. Its defence is not strong, but it needs few moves, so a quick attack can be launched while still in the crab castle.

explain.ja: 金矢倉に対して「銀矢倉」もあり、6七の駒が金ではなく銀です。銀2枚と金1枚で囲うことで駒の連結がよくなります。
explain.en: Besides Gold Yagura there is the Silver Yagura, with a silver rather than gold on 6七. Using two silvers and one gold improves the connection of the pieces.

explain.ja: 玉を7八に置いて囲うのが「片矢倉」です。通常の矢倉囲いより手数を省略できるので、その分攻めが少し早くなります。
explain.en: Placing the king on 7八 gives the Kata Yagura (half Yagura). It saves moves compared with the usual Yagura, so the attack comes slightly faster.

explain.ja: 金銀4枚で囲うのが「総矢倉」です。攻めに使う右銀を囲いにくっつけてかなり手厚くなりますが、攻めは細くなりがちです。
explain.en: Surrounding the king with four gold/silver pieces is the Sou Yagura (full Yagura). Attaching the right silver, normally used for attack, makes it thick, but the attack tends to become thin.

explain.ja: 矢倉囲いを発展させてさらに深く潜るのが「矢倉穴熊」です。ここから銀を8八にくっつけるとかなりの堅さになります。
explain.en: The Yagura Anaguma develops Yagura by burrowing the king deeper. Attaching a silver on 8八 from here makes it very solid.

explain.ja: 別名しゃがみ矢倉の「菊水矢倉」は、玉を9段目に置く構えです。棒銀のように8筋から攻めてくる相手には強さを発揮しますが、横からの攻めにはかなり弱くなります。
explain.en: The Kikusui Yagura, also called Crouching Yagura, puts the king on the ninth rank. It is strong against opponents attacking on the 8th file like Climbing Silver, but quite weak to lateral attacks.

explain.ja: 矢倉囲いの銀を前に出した形が「銀立ち矢倉」です。対振り飛車で舟囲いから発展させ、相手の美濃囲いを上部から攻める構えです。
explain.en: The Gin-dachi Yagura is a Yagura with the silver advanced. Against Ranging Rook it develops from Funagakoi and attacks the opponent's Mino castle from above.

explain.ja: 金銀4枚で囲う「菱矢倉」は、同じく4枚で囲う総矢倉よりさらに守りに重点を置き、相居飛車では無類の堅さを発揮します。
explain.en: The Hishi Yagura (diamond Yagura), also with four gold/silver pieces, emphasises defence even more than the Sou Yagura and shows unmatched firmness in double Static Rook.

explain.ja: 通常の矢倉より低い陣形で構えるのが「へこみ矢倉」です。横からの攻めにはかなり強い一方、斜めのラインは手薄です。角換わりや対角交換振り飛車などの角交換の将棋でよく使われます。
explain.en: The Hekomi Yagura (dented Yagura) is a lower formation than usual Yagura. It is quite strong against lateral attacks but thin on the diagonals. It is often used in bishop exchange games such as Bishop Exchange and Bishop-Exchange Ranging Rook.

explain.ja: 角換わりでよく用いられる囲いが「カブト囲い」です。この形のまま戦いを起こしたり、発展させて通常の矢倉囲いやへこみ矢倉を目指すのが一般的です。
explain.en: The Kabuto (helmet) castle is often used in Bishop Exchange. Players usually start fighting in this form or develop it toward the ordinary Yagura or Hekomi Yagura.

explain.ja: コンピュータ将棋ソフトBonanzaが好んで用いたとされる囲いが「ボナンザ囲い」です。対角交換振り飛車でよく使われ、へこみ矢倉より手数がかかりませんが、下段はスカスカです。
explain.en: The Bonanza castle is said to have been favoured by the shogi program Bonanza. It is often used in Bishop-Exchange Ranging Rook; it needs fewer moves than Hekomi Yagura but leaves the lower ranks empty.

explain.ja: 左金を7八ではなく5八に上げるのが「土居矢倉」です。堅さはありませんがバランスがよく、隙の少ないのが特徴です。
explain.en: The Doi Yagura raises the left gold to 5八 instead of 7八. It is not especially solid, but it is well balanced with few weaknesses.

explain.ja: 通常の矢倉を左右反転させた囲いが「右矢倉」です。主に相振り飛車で使われます。
explain.en: The Migi Yagura is the ordinary Yagura mirrored left to right. It is mainly used in double Ranging Rook.

explain.ja: 「雁木囲い」は正確には矢倉とは別の囲いですが、矢倉戦法の出だしから使われることも多く、矢倉囲いとは兄弟のような関係です。
explain.en: The Gangi castle is strictly a separate castle from Yagura, but it is often used from the start of Yagura openings and is something like a sibling of Yagura.
